resources.string: Termux is prepared automatically. Shared storage is available under ~/storage after granting Andex storage access on first launch.
Andex includes Termux and prepares it automatically on first launch. Manage its terminal and environment here.
Prepare and verify the embedded Termux runtime.
Allow AI screen and clipboard control

AI tools can access the clipboard and use your authorized ADB or accessibility connection to read and operate the real screen. Screen and clipboard content may be sent to your selected model provider. Turn this switch off to revoke these capabilities. Ordinary Termux commands remain available.

When enhanced AI phone control is enabled in Andex, this service can read visible screen content and perform taps, swipes, text entry, navigation, and screenshots. Screen content may be sent to the model provider you select. It does not grant root or ADB privileges.
Status is checked automatically when you return. See the startup error below or refresh to retry.

Available to the agent in all chats. Granted accessibility and connected ADB can be used directly, without root or Shizuku. Termux opens apps through Andex’s native identity. System permission and ADB pairing must be completed by you.
